Position Overview

AI/ML Engineer to join team at USPTO. In this role, you will assist in developing and evaluating machine learning models, preparing datasets, implementing AI solutions, and supporting the integration of intelligent systems into applications. You will work closely with other AI/ML engineers and other professionals to solve business problems using modern artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques.

Core Responsibilities

Collaboration: Work with clients, key stakeholders, as well as cross-functional teams.
Technical Performance:
Junior skills:
Feature engineering and model optimization (assisting)
Analyzing model performance with standard metrics
Working with Python, ML libraries, AI APIs
Basic NLP, computer vision, or generative AI tasks
Prompt engineering and RAG integration
SQL and data preparation
Basic Git / version control
Using AI-enabled dev tools (Claude Code, Copilot)
Minimum Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience:
Junior (0 to 4 years)
Technical Proficiency:
Experience with Python, Javascript, Java
Experience with AI coding harnesses or related methods for agentic software development
Experience with LLM engineering such as prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agentic frameworks
Experience with MLOps concepts, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and model lifecycle management.
Experience collaborating in Agile development environments and using modern DevOps tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub).
Experience with Amazon Bedrock or similar generative AI platforms
Experience working with large language models and prompt engineering
Experience with model evaluation and performance optimization
Experience developing and integrating APIs
Experience using AI-enabled development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies
Compliance: Obtain Public Trust
Preferred Expertise

Experience with document-heavy or structured-data AI applications
Experience with federal government IT systems or federal contracting
Experience with semantic search or knowledge graph systems
Familiarity with accessibility and compliance requirements (Section 508)
Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms (beyond just Bedrock)
Contributions to open-source ML projects
Publications or presentations in AI/ML
